changes.summary: Make the notification settings e2e spec close the recipient picker menu by clicking away so it cannot cover the controls below.
Fix the notification settings e2e spec so it closes the recipient picker menu before using controls below it.

Redesign notification settings and the notification center for non-technical users: one searchable recipient picker for users, groups and roles, a single delivery status line, a calmer bell dropdown and history page, and a fix for the delivery status polling itself in an endless loop.
